intent: redis2 filer store: ListDirectoryEntries now ZREMs directory-index members whose value key is gone (e.g. Redis-side TTL expiry) so the per-directory ZSET stops growing. To avoid stripping the member from a value recreated by a concurrent InsertEntry, the cleanup re-checks EXISTS after ZREM and ZAddNXs the member back when the value is present or the check failed. Single-key commands only, because redis_cluster2 has no shared hash tag.
residual_risks: With redis_cluster2 useReadOnly=true or routeByLatency=true, go-redis routes read-only commands (GET in FindEntry, EXISTS in the restore check) to replicas while ZREM/ZADD go to the master. If a stale orphan member exists, the same name is re-inserted, and a concurrent listing's replica reads lag behind the new SET, the listing can ZREM the member and skip the restore, leaving a live value with no index member until it is rewritten. Needs replica lag, a stale member, a same-name re-insert and a concurrent listing together (adversarial read, anchor 50; not confirmable without a cluster). Not present before this change, since members were never removed.

UpdateEntry (doInsertEntry only) never re-adds the index member, so the compensation only covers InsertEntry. A sub-millisecond window remains where an overwrite of an entry Redis is about to expire lands after the listing's ZREM+EXISTS. Pre-existing design; same class as the expiry-branch race the PR author already calls out of scope.
A concurrent DeleteEntry between the restore's EXISTS and its ZAddNX can re-add a member for a deleted value. It self-heals on the next listing.
testing_gaps: The new tests run only when RUN_REDIS_TESTS=1 with a live Redis; they skipped in this review (no Redis available), so the orphan-removal, TTL-expiry and keyPrefix cases were not executed here. Only build, vet and the skipped-test run were checked.
The restore branch is exercised only at the helper with the value present; the concurrent interleaving and the EXISTS-error path have no test.
